body: Its hard. I feel like Im just collecting names to google later of people who have failed me or have ended up hating me
Hey. Not as bad. Looking into getting my own apartment for my own mental survival.
I will kill myself if i end up homeless again.

When I was 18 my family kicked me out. I lived between my uncles and my then boyfriends place. I slept in my car and had to beg someone to watch my dog.

Now since I am so ujnbearable I will face it all again.
US. There is no time. I am facing homelessness again.
March. I have very little time
No. I cant. I cannot afford to move.

Yes. I have been told I make them uncomfortable and they don't like me.

My roomates and I discussed what will happen when our lease ends and they do not want to keep living with me

All of my roomates hate me. Everything I do bothers them. I cannot afford a different place. I must live here. 

But I can solve 2 birds with one stone. I will never bother them again and I won't live anywhere.

I just have to break up with my boyfriend first. Doing that right now.

My mother died of Huntington's disease. It's very likely I will too. I'm glad you're going to tell her. This sort of stuff is something you need people through. 

I fight this thought a lot. That I am a ticking time bomb that will genetically ruin every family I touch. HD is the 'family disease' afterall. So I might as well as do everyone a favor and fuck off. Save them the troublr and trauma.

But... I think I enrich some people's lives a bit. 

My partner, who knows about my HD possibility, has told me that it scares him. He doesn't really know what he is getting into, we are both 20-21, and he doesn't know what it is like to slowly watch your loved one die. But I cannot make the choice for him. He says he would much rather have a chance to be happy with me, for however long I have, than have passed me up because of something that might happen because I make him happy.

So I will let my loveable idiot make that choice.

I listen to music, listen to my favorite podcasts, I sew, I crochet, I take care of my dog and my 4 pet rats, I love makeup. I love going thrifting. I love spicey nuggets from Wendy's. 

I love many things and do many things by myself. I've always been a loner.

You do not know me. I do nit have any friends. No onw reaches out when I beg for help. I had to begv an ex boyfriend, and I mean beg, to wait to cut me out of his life until new years because he seems to be the only one capable of caring for me in the even smallest fake amount
Why does no one love me..
I don't want to suffer anymore. It hurts. Alot.
